title: Why every developer needs to learn about AI agents right now

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Every developer must learn AI agents—they’re the next fundamental layer of software infrastructure. (3 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Not every developer needs them—most work on legacy systems where AI agents add no immediate value. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: But AI agents integrate with REST, gRPC, and protocols like LangChain—enabling real-time automation everywhere. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: That’s a niche. Real-world impact comes from AI tools like LLMs, not agent frameworks that few actually use. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: AI is here to stay, but not every developer needs to build agents—just understand how they affect their work. (4 sec)
